facts.claim: LA County (unincorporated) 2026-27: $41.35 per permit issued; branch circuits $25.96 each for the first 10, $21.59 each for 11 to 40; service or panelboard up to 399 amps $58.35. Effective July 1, 2026.
facts.quote: Effective July 1, 2026 ... For issuing permits, each $ 41.35 ... For 15 or 20 ampere 120 volt lighting or general use receptacles: First 10 branch circuits, each $ 25.96 Each additional branch circuit from 11 to 40 inclusive $ 21.59 ... panelboards of 600 volts or less and not over 399 amperes in rating, each $ 58.35

facts.claim: LA County: alterations to existing residential buildings use the branch circuit or unit fee schedule.
facts.quote: For other types of residential occupancies and alterations, additions and modifications to existing residential buildings, use BRANCH CIRCUIT FEE OR UNIT FEE SCHEDULE.

facts.claim: LA County: plan checking fee is 70 percent of the electrical permit fee, minimum $164.02.
facts.quote: Plan Checking Fee: The fee shall be equal to seventy percent (70%) of the required electrical permit fee provided however, the minimum fee shall be $ 164.02

facts.claim: LA County: investigation fee for work done without a required permit equals the permit fee but not less than $504.47; $252.23 for owner-builder one or two family dwellings.
facts.quote: Investigation fee for work done without a required permit shall be equal to the permit fee, but not less than $ 504.47 Exception: One or two family dwellings, when work is performed by owner-builder $ 252.23

facts.claim: Boston: service upgrade permit $20 plus $0.25 per amp up to 240 volts; no service change: $20 plus $1 per fixture, plug or outlet.
facts.quote: When upgrading service or installing new service: $20 application fee, plus $0.25/amp up to 240 volts ... When there’s no change in service: $20 application fee, plus $1 for each fixture, plug, or outlet, and $5 for each approved meter.

facts.claim: Boston: only a licensed contractor can apply for an electrical permit.
facts.quote: Licensed contractors only You must be a licensed contractor to apply for this permit.

facts.claim: Iowa weatherization 2015: S-type fuses for knob and tube; rule of thumb 15 amp for 14-gauge, 20 amp for 12-gauge; if S-type fuses will not work because of overloaded circuits, a new service panel. (Iowa weatherization notice 15-01, 2015.)
facts.quote: Unless prohibited by local codes, S-type fuses must be installed in homes having knob and tube wiring, to provide over-current protection. If S-type fuses will not work because of overloaded circuits, a new service panel must be installed and the house brought up to code. A rule of thumb is to use 15 amp fuses for 14-gauge wire and 20 amp fuses for 12-gauge wire.

facts.claim: EWEB form: the electrician repairs defects and installs 15-amp breakers or Type S fuses if appropriate; costs usually aren't reimbursed and vary between electricians. (EWEB form dated October 2014.)
facts.quote: Repair defects; Evaluate the fusing and install 15-AMP circuit breakers or Type S fuses, if appropriate; ... You are responsible for the costs. As costs vary significantly from electrician to electrician, you may want to compare costs before selecting an electrician.
